# Siterwell Home Store

> > Official store for Siterwell IoT-based home safety products including UL-certified smoke detectors, carbon monoxide alarms, and interconnected fire protection systems.

Siterwell Home specializes in residential fire and carbon monoxide detection systems with photoelectric sensors, 10-year battery life, and hardwired interconnected capabilities. Products comply with UL 217, UL 2034, NFPA 72, and ETL certification standards for comprehensive home safety protection.
